name: ANI Pharmaceuticals
outlook:
What ANI Pharmaceuticals says to expect

  • Full year 2026: gross margin and shares outstandingANI expects full year total company adjusted non-GAAP gross margin between 60.3% and 61.0% and anticipates between approximately 21.5 million and 21.8 million shares outstanding for the purpose of calculating full year adjusted non-GAAP diluted EPS.
  • Full year 2026: tax rateThe Company now expects its annual U.S. GAAP effective tax rate to be between 27% and 29% and will continue to tax effect non-GAAP adjustments for computation of adjusted non-GAAP diluted earnings per share utilizing a tax rate of 26%.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 5, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
